summary: OFA Group filed an 8-K/A to correct a previously filed material definitive agreement. The agreement is a Real World Asset Tokenization Service Agreement with MD Queens Development LLC, where OFA will provide blockchain tokenization infrastructure services for a real estate development project. OFA receives a $15 million technology fee, payable in two milestones. OFA explicitly states it is not acting as an issuer, broker-dealer, or fundraising intermediary. This is a routine business services contract, not a special situation. The filing solely corrects an exhibit error.
